about: Monthly climate normals by place class, measured. Made by Bake/weather/make_normals.py from KNMI's open station data (raw files and SHA-256 sums in Bake/weather/raw). Wind in m/s at 10 m; beaufort = % of hours at force 0..12 (beaufortNoDay: the same with the day's cycle divided out); windByHour and tempByHour by UT hour 0-23 (the hour ending at 1..24 UT); days* = % of days whose strongest hourly mean reached the force; temperatures C; days a month; rose = % of days by the day's vector-mean wind direction (N NE E SE S SW W NW).

seaTemp.source: guess (weather document 1.1); to be replaced by Rijkswaterstaat's monthly means

yearOffset.about: The user's decision 17 (4 Oct 2026): the climate of 793 is the modern normals cooled by 0.8 C, warming into the Medieval Climate Anomaly by about 950 (summers 0.3 C over the modern normals, winters as now); Eldgja's haze cooled 939-942 (weather document 1.2).
